label: Weekend restructure: Lantau moves to Sunday Nov 1 flight morning (in-town check-in + lounge lunch); Saturday Oct 31 becomes the slow day
notes: v17 (Milo, Oct 30, at Justin's decision): the Hong Kong weekend restructures. Lantau moves from Sat Oct 31 to Sun Nov 1: 8:00 AM Conrad shuttle to Hong Kong Station, Cathay in-town check-in (bags through to JFK; MTR lists CX at Hong Kong Station 6:00 AM–11:00 PM, 24h to 90 min before departure), Tung Chung Line, Ngong Ping 360 (Standard cabin round trip on the Klook voucher — NOT Crystal; the official webstore was sold out for Oct 31 and the Standard was Justin's pick), Big Buddha + Po Lin in the compressed flight-day cut (no monastery lunch), hard down-queue deadline 12:30 PM, blue Lantau taxi or S1 bus from Tung Chung to HKG arriving ~1:10–1:25 PM (Justin's window: 1:30–2:00 PM at the latest). Lunch is an airport lounge lunch at Justin's direction — and since CX840 is a business ticket, Cathay's own lounges lead: The Pier Business (Gate 65) first, The Wing Business for low gates; Centurion (Gate 60, Amex) and Kyra (Gate 23, Priority Pass) as the alternatives he asked to have picked. Saturday Oct 31 becomes the slow day: sleep in, Hong Kong Park late morning (moved from Sunday), flexible lunch, lounge 3–5 PM, Peak sunset, Golden Leaf — unchanged evening. The Lantau deep dive moved from guide-2026-10-31.html to guide-2026-11-01.html, retimed for Sunday and rewritten for the Standard queue, the booth-ticket optionality, and the Tung Chung → HKG leg. The Hong Kong Park farewell narration (stop8) no longer matches Nov 1 and was removed from that guide; the stop6a narration question is moot — no Stop 6 player existed in the Oct 31 guide at v17. Narration regeneration is optional (agents/TODO). The v14 Saturday 8:45-shuttle addendum is superseded: the shuttle that matters now is Sunday 8:00 AM.
